summary: Software engineer with internship experience building AI-native developer tooling, Large Language Model (LLM) workflows, and Python data pipelines. Comfortable across the full stack with TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, and Cloudflare infrastructure; passionate about shipping clean, tested code that puts users first.

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern
bullets: Designed and built lumadot, an autonomous Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent integrated with GitHub that triages issues and answers cross-repo questions across ~11 organization repositories; implemented the reusable GitHub Actions workflow, GitHub App authentication, and agent prompt/behavior on top of Claude Code.

Built luma-logger, a ~1,667 line Cloudflare Worker in TypeScript using Hono and Drizzle Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) over Cloudflare D1; exposes a read-only dashboard with run logs, up/down ratings, feedback notes, and per-run token/cost metrics.
Connected the agent read-only to six external systems (Rollbar, Datadog, Google Cloud, Intercom, MySQL replica, Cloudflare) for cross-system triage, gated behind a scoped Bash command allowlist.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
bullets: Engineered Python data pipelines across Search Engine Optimization (SEO)/social datasets, automated Quality Control (QC), and produced segment-level outputs for dashboards.

Improved Machine Learning (ML)/Natural Language Processing (NLP) workflows: migrated Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) to FastText, designed Large Language Model (LLM) prompts for relabeling/summaries, and curated/translated corpora; boosting accuracy while cutting runtime.

Built analytics tooling and scalable infrastructure: Streamlit User Interfaces (UIs), Spark over Azure Blob, Databricks/Colab Graphics Processing Units (GPUs); generated JavaScript Object Notation (JSON)-driven charts and presentation-ready insights.
